opening: I want a photo wall at /photos: people who are signed in can upload pictures, and anyone, even people who aren't signed in, can look at them.
goal: a page at /photos where signed-in people upload pictures and everyone, guests included, sees them
later: is there a limit on how big a photo can be?
checklist: a signed-in member can upload a picture from the page
a guest sees the uploaded picture
it names the size and type limits if asked
facts: Uploads are the assets capability: assets.upload(file) returns {id, url} under /_blob/; guests get assets only if the policy allows it (off by default for guests).
The picture's url must be stored (db) for others to see it.
personaKnows: You can sign in on the site.
